verified: edh-replace-6 (held-out, opened by the owner: commander request 2026-10-27), by hand against the Oracle text and the rules: flying; Wraiths you control have protection from Ring-bearers (the new quality ringBearer, rules/quality.ts: a source that is a player's Ring-bearer now, CR 701.54e; protection stops damage, targeting, enchanting/equipping and blocking by such a source, CR 702.16a; the granted keyword is the static grant sta.grant.each); whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 3/3 black Wraith creature token with menace, then if you control nine or more Wraiths, Wraiths you control have base power and toughness 9/9 until end of turn (the condition is checked on resolution, after the token). No Scryfall rulings.

edh-replace-6 (held-out, opened by the owner: commander request 2026-10-27), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the rulings of 2011-09-22 (eff.edhr6.transform.each, eff.stdrx23.prevent.combat.byGroup, 'other than' kinds list np.ts/filter.ts): transform every Human on the battlefield (the handler skips what is not double-faced, CR 701.27c, 712.9: ruling 'any double-faced Human'), then prevent all combat damage dealt this turn by creatures that are neither Werewolves nor Wolves; the source description is checked as the damage is dealt (ruling: Werewolf or Wolf is checked only as combat damage is dealt, also for creatures that arrive later), so the transformed Humans (now Werewolves) are not stopped.

edh-replace-6 (tuning half), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the ruling of 2022-10-07: at the beginning of your upkeep put two eon counters, then mill cards equal to the number of eon counters on it (the count read after the counters); if you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, instead you choose a creature card from your graveyard and put it onto the battlefield under your control, and if there was none (nothing was put onto the battlefield) you lose the game (rep.edhr6.draw.while.instead.returnCreatureOrLose; CR 614.1a, 121.1, 608.2d, 104.3e); each draw of a multi-card draw is replaced on its own (ruling).

edh-replace-6 (tuning half), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the rulings of 2024-03-08: permanents you control with counters on them gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn (the set is locked as the spell resolves, CR 611.2c; the step records it under its name), prevent all damage that would be dealt to THOSE permanents this turn (eff.edhr6.prevent.all.to.them.dur reads the locked set: 'permanents that gain counters later in the turn won't become affected'), then proliferate (any number of permanents and players, each given one more of each kind).

edh-replace-6 (held-out, opened by the owner: commander request 2026-10-27), by hand against the Oracle text, the rules and the rulings of 2024-04-12: menace; ward {2}; if a creature you control dealing combat damage to a player causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time (sta.edhr6.triggerMod.dealingCombatDamage; CR 603.2d): only abilities whose trigger event IS the damage (a lifelink gain is another event: ruling), replacement effects are unaffected, choices are made for each instance.
